item.title: MIT AI stroke rehabilitation robot learns from therapists
item.summary: MIT researchers have developed an AI stroke rehabilitation system that uses generative AI and force-sensitive robot control to learn how physiotherapists physically assist patients. Rather than simply reproducing a predetermined movement, the system is designed to learn how much assistance to provide in response to touch, resistance and the patient’s own effort.
